title: Key.M is emitted and Toggle_Mute is handled, but no hunk ever produces the Toggle_Mute intent — the mute toggle is unreachable
location: app/input/poll.odin:hunk + app/input/exec.odin:hunk (Key→Intent translation layer has no hunk in the diff)
detail: Diff adds the M keypress, the Key enum member, the intent variant, and the handler — but the untouched device-event→Intent translation layer constructs no Toggle_Mute, so on_mute never fires.
recommended_fix: Add the Key.M case (or table entry) to the input translation layer mapping Key_Press{.M} to Toggle_Mute, and cover the harness-scripted key path with a test.

title: Single last-writer-wins caption slot: 'packet delivered' instantly overwrites a crisis caption, breaking the every-alert-captioned claim
evidence:
+			set_caption(&a.caption, crisis_caption(&a.caption, cat, e), e.tick)
...
+			set_caption(&a.caption, "packet delivered", e.tick)
detail: Any unthrottled arrival after a crisis in the same event slice replaces the crisis caption immediately; the 2 s dwell and the 'caption for every alert' a11y claim only hold for the last event.
recommended_fix: Give captions priority levels (crisis over arrival) or per-alert caption slots; a lower-priority arrival must not overwrite a live crisis caption.

title: u8 pending play counters accumulate unboundedly in the harness mirror, which never calls audio_flush
detail: The app resets pending via audio_flush each frame; the harness mirror never flushes, so 256+ unthrottled arrivals across the run overflow the u8 (wrap, or trap on checked builds).
recommended_fix: Widen the play counters (u32/uint), or reset/flush pending per tick in the harness mirror so the counters stay bounded.

title: SYNTH_RAMP_S is declared but never referenced — the ramp length 110 is hardcoded separately
evidence:
+SYNTH_RAMP_S      :: f32(0.005) // 5 ms attack/release — no click artifacts
+SYNTH_RAMP_SAMPLES :: 110       // int(0.005 s * 22050 Hz) — a constant (110.25 truncates)
detail: No reference to SYNTH_RAMP_S anywhere in the diff; even the comment derives 110 from it instead of the code. Dead constant that can silently drift from the hardcoded ramp.
recommended_fix: Define SYNTH_RAMP_SAMPLES :: int(SYNTH_RAMP_S * SYNTH_SAMPLE_RATE), or delete SYNTH_RAMP_S.

title: audio.dem header claims Packet_Arrived events flow from tick ~16, but the first explicit spawn is at 2000 ms = tick 40
evidence:
+# 60 s) plus explicit res->host spawns so Packet_Arrived events flow from
+# tick ~16 on.
...
+at 2000ms spawn 0 2
detail: At the pinned 20 Hz the first spawn (2000 ms) is tick 40, so spawn-driven arrivals cannot begin at tick 16; the recipe comment is stale or misattributes arrival timing.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to match the spawn schedule, or move the first spawn earlier if tick ~16 arrivals were intended.
